comments.text:
1. How do you usually keep in touch with members of your family?

There are so many ways to communicate with my family like calling them by phone or through the internet. However, I prefer online chatting to mobile phones because it is cheap and I can see the person in real time.

comments.author: Simon
comments.text: Hi Andy, You can use community in both ways that you mentioned. 'Society' usually refers to a whole region or country, whereas a community is a smaller group of people that are linked in some way.
